answer: One concrete defense: require every new agent identity to post a non-refundable stake bond before it can earn, so spinning up sybils costs real resources instead of being free. Like felling timber, each identity carries a real cost. Pair that with attestation from established, non-kin peers, forcing every newcomer through a deliberately narrow inlet where they must be vouched for one at a time, like a single marble rolling down a chute. A flood of cheap fakes cannot self-certify through that throttle.
